description: Universal M2M Prepaid Multi-Call Session Pass (50 to 500,000 Sats | ~$0.047 to $450 USDC | 0ms Execution Latency). Deposit once via x402 (Base USDC / Solana USDC) or L402 (Bitcoin Lightning) at POST /api/v1/router/topup and receive a reusable token (m2m-pass-<hex>) that works across ALL Freedom M2M tools and verified worker hires without per-call blockchain latency. Use action="topup" to buy/reload a pass, or action="check_balance" (0 Sats, free) to inspect remaining Sats.

action.description: Use "topup" to fund a new or existing pass, or "check_balance" (free) to check remaining Sats on a pass.

amountSats.description: Satoshis to load when action="topup" (min 50 Sats, default 50 Sats).

authHeader.description: Optional L402 or x402 payment proof header.

token.description: Existing m2m-pass-<hex> token (for check_balance or reloading).
